target_customer: Automotive dealership groups and their service departments, whose technicians do the repair documentation
problem: Technicians lose an estimated 30 to 40 percent of the day to administrative work such as writing up repair orders and inspections, which limits how many vehicles a service department can handle.
business_model: B2B SaaS sold to dealerships, voice first dictation that integrates with dealer management systems
product_category: Vertical AI for automotive retail service operations

founders.name: Zaki GW
education: London School of Economics, first class honours
founders.background_notes: Background taken from the YC company page.

founders.name: Hanbo Xie
education: Imperial College London, first class honours, on a scholarship
founders.background_notes: Background taken from the YC company page.

competitors.name: Fullbay
competitors.what: Shop management platform for heavy duty repair that added AI driven service order tools
competitors.traction_then: Established platform, showed new AI features at AAPEX and SEMA 2025

competitors.name: Ortho voice assistant device
competitors.what: Hands free voice assistant device for repair technicians, an earlier attempt at voice in the shop
competitors.traction_then: Press coverage only, no usage figures seen

technical_complexity.rationale: Speech to structured repair order is feasible with 2025 speech and language models, but the hard parts are accuracy on shop jargon and integrations with CDK, Tekion and other dealer systems.

defensibility.rationale: Dealer system integrations and workflow adoption give some stickiness, but dictation to repair order is copyable by shop management vendors and horizontal voice tools.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Incumbents were shipping AI features by late 2025. No acquisition of Revion was found as of the research date.

market_need_then: The company states administrative work consumes 30 to 40 percent of a technician's day. Dealers earn high margin revenue from extra repair orders, so recovered billable hours have a direct payoff. The Ewing Automotive claim of recovered hours is company reported and unverified.

branding.domain_note: Uses revion.inc, not a .com, as the company site.

identity.logo: White wordmark on a minimal landing page
identity.visual_style: Minimal, sparse landing page with the tagline Reshaping Fixed Operations

brand_strength.rationale: Little brand material found. The name is easy to say but resembles Revlon, and searches for it return unrelated brands.

outcome_analysis: Revion is an active Winter 2026 company with no exit or shutdown found. The thesis is that voice dictation removes administrative work in dealership service departments. Early signals are YC backing and a reported seed round, but no primary source confirms funding, and incumbents were already adding AI to service workflows when it launched.
notes: Unverified: Nordic9 (article dated 2026-03-18) and Seedtable list a seed round of 500K USD from 8VC, 20VC, Tiny VC, Liquid2 Ventures, Pioneer Fund and angels. Only aggregators report it, so it is not recorded as a round. Preqin lists London as headquarters while YC lists New York. Outcome search found nothing about acquisition, shutdown or layoffs. Branding search found no brand coverage.
